Tòa tháp nằm sát biển Sơn Thủy, nên căn: The tower stands right by Son Thuy Beach, so east-facing units are exposed to more wind and salt air than units at the back. At the Sun Saphia Residence handover, for sea-facing units you should check three more things: the rubber seals and tracks of the balcony glass doors (open and close them several times, listen for squeaks and look for light gaps), the balcony floor drain (pour a bucket of water to see if it all flows to the drain), and metal parts such as handles and hinges (look for early rust spots). These are small issues at handover but can easily become big problems after one rainy and storm season.
